data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter widget for building stepper-based list UIs like timelines and event logs.
data.what_it_does: StepperListView provides a custom list view widget where each item is rendered as a step containing an avatar or icon, step labels, and rich custom content areas connected by a customizable line.
use_when: You need to build an activity timeline or event history log UI.
You want custom avatars, step labels, and content builders alongside a vertical connecting line.
avoid_when: You only need standard linear Flutter Stepper widgets without custom list scrolling requirements.
You need a complex horizontal layout stepper.
strengths: Highly customizable UI with dedicated avatar, step label, and content builders.
Supports solid and dashed connecting lines with configurable width and colors.
weaknesses: Limited to vertical stepper list layouts.
Relies on external state handling or custom data structures like StepperItemData.
data.minimal_example:
StepperListView(
  showStepperInLast: true,
  stepperData: _stepperData,
  stepAvatar: (_, data) => const CircleAvatar(),
  stepWidget: (_, data) => const Text('Step'),
  stepContentWidget: (_, data) => const Text('Content'),
)
